script: "Pedro betrayed us for money—my friend called me the asshole, but I didn't believe it.". It was Emma's birthday, and the plan was simple: a small dinner with us five—me, Emma, Pedro, Faith, and Zoey, her roommate. I'd already said no to a fancy outing because I am juggling a freelance gig and just left a higher‑paying job, so cash was tight. Emma and I had decided to cancel the whole thing. Pedro was the one pushing everyone to finalize. When I told him we were broke and not going, he asked, "Are you asking me for money?" I said nope, just explaining why. He then threw in his brand‑new credit card to hit a bonus. We decided he'd put my meal and half of Emma's on his card, and I'd pay him back Monday. Straightforward. I also asked if he could drive me home after the meal because an Uber one‑way and a ride back with him was cheaper than driving alone. He said yeah. Faith finished work late, so we waited to order until she got there. Before she arrived, Pedro somehow ordered three appetizers for himself and ate them while we were waiting. When Faith finally showed up, we ordered. Pedro even nudged Emma to add a caviar bump. I stepped outside for a cigarette—only one entrance, so I was right outside. When I came back, Pedro was gone. Everyone assumed he'd said goodbye outside, but he hadn't. I asked the waiter what Pedro had paid for. Only his own appetizers. If he'd left before we ordered, I'd just skip it. He stayed through ordering, knew the agreement, and then vanished with his bill. I couldn't reach my boyfriend or parents for cash, so I told Faith what happened. She offered to cover it, but after checking her account she didn't have enough either. We pooled every dollar we had to cover the bill. No tip. I still feel awful about that. Faith had to drive me home because Pedro had disappeared. A few days later, Pedro called. He said I was the asshole for "feeling entitled to his money." I told him I thought he was the jerk for proposing the arrangement, staying through ordering, then leaving without warning and only paying for himself, leaving me scrambling to cover my meal and my ride. He laughed and called me entitled. (I know, right?) So… am I the jerk?
